content.comment_body: Hello! I just noticed there's a USB to [product_name] cable available. [article_no] It seems like many users have been requesting this.
Is anyone aware whether this USB cable works with Mac OS X?

analysis.insight_summary: Users are interested in a newly released USB to [product_name] cable and are looking for information about its compatibility with MacOS. There is a need for clearer details on product compatibility, especially for those using operating systems other than Windows.
analysis.user_expectations: Users are hoping the USB to [product_name] cable will work smoothly on different operating systems, including MacOS.
